items.title: EPA quietly backtracks on claims US has phased out toxic Pfas compounds
items.title_en: EPA quietly backtracks on claims US has phased out toxic Pfas compounds
items.title_zh: 美国环保署悄然收回了关于美国已逐步淘汰有毒全氟烷基物质（PFAS）的说法
items.summary_en: Agency changes wording on website as Texas-based firm continues manufacture of plastic container barriersThe Environmental Protection Agency has quietly backtracked on a claim that the US has phased out two of the most dangerous Pfas compounds – Pfoa and Pfos.The EPA has found that virtually no level of exposure to either in drinking water is safe, and the International Agency for Research on Cancer classifies Pfoa as “carcinogenic to humans” and Pfos as “possibly carcinogenic”. Still, the EPA is allowing Houston-based Inhance to produce containers from which Pfoa has been found to leach at high levels into the containers’ contents. The company makes up to 200m barriers annually for plastic containers used across the US economy.This article was amended on 18 October 2026 to correct Patricia van Ee’s title, and the story previously stated that Inhance manufactures plastic containers. They make the containers’ barriers. Continue reading...

items.title_en: A 24-year study uncovers a surprising climate benefit beneath forests
items.title_zh: 一项为期24年的研究揭示了森林之下令人惊讶的气候效益
items.summary_en: Scientists have discovered that some forest soils are becoming surprisingly better at removing methane from the atmosphere as temperatures rise and rainfall declines. A study spanning up to 24 years found methane absorption increasing by an average of 3% annually, challenging previous predictions about climate change's effects on forests.
items.summary_zh: 科学家发现，随着气温升高和降雨减少，某些森林土壤清除大气中甲烷的能力竟出人意料地增强了。一项历时长达24年的研究发现，甲烷吸收量平均每年增加3%，这挑战了此前关于气候变化对森林影响的预测。

items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 16 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01950-4Materials discovery by artificial intelligence rarely considers scalability, environmental impacts or end-of-life management, prioritizing functional performance. This Perspective suggests a roadmap for embedding life-cycle considerations in the discovery process to design sustainable materials from the start.

items.title: Low solar grazing densities support beneficial insects in agrivoltaic systems
items.title_en: Low solar grazing densities support beneficial insects in agrivoltaic systems
items.title_zh: 较低的太阳能系统植被覆盖密度有助于在农光互补系统中维持益虫种群
items.summary_en: Solar grazing—the co-location of livestock grazing and photovoltaic energy production—is rapidly expanding globally to mitigate land-use conflicts. Solar facilities are increasingly sited on agricultural land, where both sheep grazing and the promotion of agriculturally beneficial insects are recognized as facilitators of multi-functional agroecosystems, yet how stocking rate shapes beneficial insect communities remains poorly understood. We conducted a replicated, three-year experiment testing six stocking rates (0–10 sheep ha−1) at an operational 18 MW solar facility, sampling bees and lady beetles across three years and four grazing rotations per year. Light grazing at 2 sheep ha−1 supported 38% greater beneficial insect abundance than ungrazed controls, driven primarily by an 83% increase in honey bees. High stocking rates (⩾8 sheep ha−1) reduced bee abundance by 42%–68% and significantly changed insect community composition. A companion study identified 8 sheep ha−1 as the agrotechnological optimum, but our results identify 2 sheep ha−1 as the agroecological optimum in our study region, where beneficial insect abundance and flock health are maximized. These optima did not coincide, indicating a clear tradeoff between ecological and operational objectives. However, at 4 sheep ha−1, beneficial insect communities remained statistically indistinguishable from ungrazed controls while vegetation management effectiveness was greater than at 2 sheep ha−1. Together these results define a synergy–tradeoff boundary with direct implications for targeting agroecological outcomes via the operations and maintenance of solar grazing facilities.
items.summary_zh: 太阳能放牧——即牲畜放牧与光伏发电的共址——正在全球范围内迅速扩展，以缓解土地利用冲突。 太阳能设施越来越多地建在农田上，在那里，绵羊放牧和有益农业的昆虫的培育均被公认为多功能农业生态系统的促进因素，但放牧密度如何影响有益昆虫群落，目前仍知之甚少。 我们在一座正在运营的18兆瓦太阳能发电设施中开展了一项为期三年、设有多组重复试验的实验，测试了六种放牧密度（0–10只羊/公顷），并在三年内、每年四个放牧轮作周期中对蜜蜂和瓢虫进行了采样。 每公顷2只羊的轻度放牧，其益虫丰度比未放牧的对照组高出38%，这主要得益于蜜蜂数量增加了83%。高放牧密度（≥8只羊/公顷）使蜜蜂丰度减少了42%–68%，并显著改变了昆虫群落组成。 一项配套研究将8只羊/公顷确定为农业技术上的最优值，但我们的研究结果表明，在研究区域内，2只羊/公顷是农业生态学上的最优值，此时有益昆虫数量和羊群健康状况均达到最大化。这两个最优值并不重合，表明生态目标与运营目标之间存在明显的权衡关系。 然而，在每公顷4只羊的放牧密度下，益虫群落与未放牧对照组在统计上仍无显著差异，而植被管理效果却优于每公顷2只羊的放牧密度。综合来看，这些结果界定了协同效应与权衡之间的边界，对通过太阳能放牧设施的运营和维护来实现农业生态目标具有直接的指导意义。

items.title: Cyclonic and zonal vertical circulation drive a distinct type of heatwaves over South China
items.title_en: Cyclonic and zonal vertical circulation drive a distinct type of heatwaves over South China
items.title_zh: 气旋式和纬向垂直环流在华南地区引发了一种独特的热浪
items.summary_en: Under global warming, heatwaves over South China (SC) have increased substantially, posing severe threats to socioeconomic systems and human health. Previous studies have primarily emphasized the role of anomalous horizontal anticyclones, while the active dynamical contribution of large-scale vertical circulation remains insufficiently understood. Using the three-pattern decomposition of global atmospheric circulation, we identify two distinct circulation regimes among SC heatwave events during 1979–2022 from a new perspective of three-dimensional circulation dynamics: meridional circulation-dominated type (MC-type) regime and zonal circulation-dominated type (ZC-type) regime. MC-type heatwaves resemble conventional events, with barotropic anticyclonic anomalies and meridional subsidence that are jointly regulated by North Atlantic and tropical Pacific sea surface temperature anomalies. In contrast, ZC-type heatwaves are associated with lower-tropospheric cyclonic circulation and zonal circulation anomalies, with their occurrence favored by central Pacific warming and enhanced tropical cyclone activity over the western North Pacific. Notably, ZC-type heatwaves exhibit pronounced hot-humid characteristics and show a significant increasing trend after 2000. Our study deepens the understanding of the dynamical mechanisms of SC heatwaves and may provide useful insights for future subseasonal prediction of SC heatwaves.
items.summary_zh: 在全球变暖的背景下，华南地区的热浪事件显著增加，对社会经济体系和人类健康构成了严重威胁。以往的研究主要侧重于异常水平反气旋的作用，而大尺度垂直环流的积极动力学贡献仍未得到充分理解。 基于全球大气环流的三模式分解方法，我们从三维环流动力学的新视角出发，识别出1979–2022年间华南热浪事件中的两种截然不同的环流模式： 以子午向环流为主导的类型（MC型）和以经向环流为主导的类型（ZC型）。MC型热浪与传统热浪事件相似，表现为等压反气旋异常和子午向下沉，这两者共同受北大西洋和热带太平洋海表温度异常的调控。 相比之下，ZC型热浪则与对流层下层的气旋性环流及纬向环流异常相关，其中太平洋中部变暖以及西北太平洋热带气旋活动增强是其发生的主要促成因素。 值得注意的是，ZC型热浪表现出明显的湿热特征，且自2000年以来呈现显著的增长趋势。本研究深化了对南半球热浪动力机制的理解，并可能为未来南半球热浪的亚季节预报提供有益的见解。

items.title_zh: 戒瘾治疗中的药物——科学与污名之冲突 | 科学
items.summary_en: Is it useful to regard addiction as a moral failing or as a medical challenge? Drug use or alcohol binges during adolescence might be seen as a sign of deviance from society rules or weakness, but substance dependence, once established, is a health care problem. There are now treatments available to break “the chains of abject slavery [that] have wound themselves around the constitution” and to maintain an improved health status. Individual determination is sometimes sufficient, but pharmacologic and psychological support increase the likelihood of long-term improved health. A moral perspective about addiction, however, creates obstacles for people who are recovering from it and associates stigma with the mechanisms that can support recovery. If the individual in treatment is taking their medication daily, as prescribed, then is this evidence of addiction or of good adherence? In this area, even scientists sometimes struggle to apply the objectivity that they usually employ in other areas of their research.
items.summary_zh: 将成瘾视为道德缺陷还是医学挑战，这有意义吗？青少年时期的吸毒或酗酒行为或许会被视为偏离社会规范或意志薄弱的迹象，但一旦形成物质依赖，它便成为一个医疗健康问题。 如今已有治疗手段，能够打破“缠绕在身体机能上的可悲奴役枷锁”，并维持改善后的健康状态。个人的决心有时就已足够，但药物和心理支持能提高长期改善健康状况的可能性。 然而，从道德角度看待成瘾问题，不仅会给正在康复的人设置障碍，还会使本应支持康复的机制蒙上污名。如果接受治疗的个体每天按处方服药，这究竟是成瘾的证据，还是良好依从性的体现？ 在这个领域，就连科学家有时也难以运用他们在其他研究领域通常采用的客观性。
